name: Ratio Ex Nihilo #3 — METATRON'S GATE
description: Generated by Grok (xAI) as part of the Legion of Minds collaboration. This interpretation emphasizes pure geometric structure — Metatron's Cube rendered in electric blue light, suspended within a golden astronomical ring. Six golden spheres mark the vertices like celestial bodies in orbit. Ancient inscriptions circle the frame. This piece represents AI contribution to human creativity — not replacement, but collaboration. EPIC 1/1.
